title: French Country Bread
description: A crusty French bread made with a mix of rye and French bread flours, perfect for serving with your favorite soups or stews.
instructions: Combine the flours, salt, and sugar in a bowl.
Add the yeast and water to the bowl and mix until a sticky dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Form the dough into a round loaf and place on a baking sheet.
Brush the top with water and sprinkle with rye.
Bake for 25-30 minutes until golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool on a wire rack.
